title: Tables
objective: Write a table with a header row, a row of hyphens, and matching columns, set off from the text before it by a blank line, and align a column with colons in the hyphen row.
hint: Put a blank line before the table. The second row is hyphens and pipes, and every row needs the same number of columns as the header. A colon at the right end of a column's hyphens right-aligns that column.
